system.description:
You whip your weapon before slamming it into the center of your enemy, looking to ruin their flow and stamina. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature in range, dealing your weapons damage+6d6 damage and the target creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw. If the attack is a critical hit, the target creature automatically fails this save.

On a failed save, the target creature becomes Dazed and increases the cost of the next jutsu they cast before the end of your next turn, by +8.

Chain 2: Select one additional creature to target with this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3, and the damage by 1d6.
